question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

At a snail’s pace
solution:
The correct answer is **"very slowly" **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ** At a snail's pace **is an idiom.
 
• A Snail is a small creature which walks at a very low pace(speed)
 
• The meaning of At a snail's pace:
 
 
• **At a snail's pace**- very slowly.
 
 
 
• Look at some examples:
 
 
• The government is working **at a snail's pace **to deliver the final result of the exam.
 
• I drive my car **at a snail's pace**.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is ***At a snail's pace**.*
